title: Storage
description: Manage local files and keep a recoverable copy of your library.
logical_cache: Moodle response payloads use {{size}} inside the database total.
cache_limit: Response cache limit: 32 MiB. Clearing it keeps courses, reminders, conversations, and imported documents.
clear_cache_copy: Remove cached responses, course contents, and thumbnails. Moodle downloads these again when connected. Your reminders and imported files stay.
clear_converted_copy: Remove generated Markdown and AI improvements. Original documents and conversations stay. Retry conversion from each document to read it again.
backup_copy: Backups include the database and library with an integrity manifest. They contain private coursework and conversations. Keep them somewhere safe. Passwords, tokens, provider settings, and converter installations are excluded.
restore_copy: Validate a VStudy backup, then replace the database and library after restart. Current data remains in a recovery copy. Moodle accounts need to reconnect. Other application settings and secrets stay on this computer.
integrity_ok: Database integrity and foreign keys are valid.
integrity_failed: The database integrity check failed. Preserve your files and restore a verified backup.
integrity_issues: The database check found {{count}} issues. Keep a copy of your data before trying recovery.
busy: Storage maintenance is running. Wait for it to finish and retry.
disk_full: The disk is full. Free space and retry. Existing originals remain available.
permission: VStudy cannot write to this location. Choose a writable folder or check its permissions.
failed: The storage operation failed. Retry or choose another location.
invalid_backup: This backup is invalid or incomplete. Your current library has not been replaced.
backup_too_large: This backup exceeds the 4 GiB ZIP limit. Export a smaller library.
changed_during_backup: A file changed during backup. Retry after other file operations finish.
unsafe_file: The library contains an unsupported link. Remove the link before exporting.
converted_removed: Converted files were cleared. Retry conversion to read this document.
scheduled: Backup validated. Restart to finish restoring. New work is paused until restart.
